bs_total_liabilities.zh-TW: 負債總額只是右邊的一部分，還要加上股東權益才會等於資產總計。
bs_total_liabilities.en: Total liabilities are only part of the right side; equity has to be added before it equals total assets.

bs_total_equity.zh-TW: 股東權益總額是資產扣掉負債之後剩下的部分；這家店有負債，所以它比資產總計小，要再加上負債總額才會相等。
bs_total_equity.en: Total equity is what remains after deducting liabilities from assets; this shop has liabilities, so it is smaller than total assets, and only adding total liabilities makes the two equal.

prompt.zh-TW: 這是小嵐的「月光書店」的{{term:tm_sf72dfsv}}。表的左邊列的是資產，最下面那列「資產總計」永遠會和右邊的哪一列相等？請在表上點出那一列。
prompt.en: Here is the {{term:tm_sf72dfsv}} of Lan’s shop Moonlight Books. The left side lists the assets; which line on the right is always equal to the bottom line, ‘total assets’? Tap that line on the sheet.

explanation.zh-TW: 資產負債表的右邊說明資產的錢從哪裡來：一部分是欠別人的（負債），一部分是股東的（股東權益）。兩者加總的「負債及股東權益總計」才會等於左邊的{{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}。
explanation.en: The right side of the balance sheet shows where the money for the assets came from: partly from others (liabilities) and partly from the shareholders (equity). Only their sum, total liabilities and equity, equals {{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}} on the left.
